$comment: Claude Desktop config (claude_desktop_config.json). Claude Desktop launches LOCAL stdio servers from this file. Replace /ABSOLUTE/PATH with your clone path (after: npm install && npm run build). API keys are read from env — fill in only the ones you use; keyless providers (Backpack, Phoenix, Raydium, Sunrise, Clawd catalog) work with none. Trading/broadcast tools stay OFF unless you add the opt-in flags from .env.example (IMPERIAL_ALLOW_TRADING=1 etc.). The HOSTED gateway is added separately in Desktop: Settings -> Connectors -> Add custom connector -> https://mcp.clawdcompute.us/mcp
